capabilities: Embed a Misskey note in quote format from its pasted URL
Post the current line to Misskey as a note
Attach images and videos from the same line to posts
Configure tagging text, visibility range, and upload file filters
Anonymize uploaded file names and switch embed output between HTML and Markdown
extras: Setup uses MiAuth via a Generate Access Token button that opens a browser to grant note and drive permissions; Direct visibility is not supported; contact channels include GitHub, a Misskey handle, and a Google Form.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to post notes to Misskey or turn a Misskey note URL into an embedded quote inside a note.

relations.evidence: A Misskey account is required to use these features.

summary: Connects Obsidian to the Misskey social network: it embeds Misskey notes as quotes and posts the current note line with attached media.
